column1: # Default layout for boards with 32 MB flash (reTerminal E-series).
# Two app slots (app0 / app1) for OTA + an `nvs` partition for device id / token.
# A separate `prov` partition holds the optional first-boot provisioning blob
# (WiFi creds + optional claim code). On first successful boot the firmware
# migrates the contents of `prov` into `nvs` and erases `prov`.
